screens.title: Title screen
screens.purpose: Make returning to a dynasty feel like entering a sports game.
screens.layout: Full-bleed miniature campus at dusk; PAWA wordmark upper left; a single vertical play menu at left; small account and audio controls top right.
screens.primaryAction: Continue most recent dynasty; New dynasty and Join league are secondary.
screens.data: Last played dynasty, season/week, mode and cloud/session status without a dashboard of statistics.
screens.art: Approved campus art, restrained stadium light and a brass selected-menu marker.
screens.narrow: Crop campus around diamond; retain vertical play menu and top menu button, never a bottom tab bar.
screens.input: Pointer or keyboard menu selection; proposed D-pad menu and confirm/cancel; no hover-only options.
screens.states: Signed out, returning account, guest, no dynasty, unavailable server; distinguish unavailable from empty.
screens.acceptance: Continue targets the actual last accessible dynasty; all entry actions remain visible at 1280×800 and 390px.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.purpose: Resume an account with minimal friction.
screens.layout: A quiet club entrance backdrop and one centered credentials panel; back to title at top; recovery/help contextual.
screens.primaryAction: Sign in.
screens.data: Field labels, validation, pending state and intended return destination; never reveal credentials in diagnostics.
screens.art: Cropped campus entrance with low contrast behind form; same Sora/Inter as game.
screens.narrow: One-column form with inset top close/back; keyboard opening never covers submit.
screens.input: Normal text entry and password-manager semantics; intended controller invokes platform keyboard only after future integration.
screens.states: Invalid credentials, disconnected, pending request and successful redirect; suppress duplicate submission.
screens.acceptance: Labels stay visible when populated; submit errors preserve inputs safely and return focus to the failing field.

screens.title: Create account
screens.purpose: Create a durable coach identity before joining or saving a dynasty.
screens.layout: One identity form on a muted clubhouse backdrop; explain save ownership adjacent to creation action.
screens.primaryAction: Create account.
screens.data: Only actual required account fields and clear password requirements; preserve destination from invite.
screens.art: Clubhouse signage and monogram without an invented avatar customization step.
screens.narrow: Stack fields in a single panel; top back action stays available.
screens.input: Keyboard field order and submit; planned controller text-entry flow shares same validation.
screens.states: Duplicate identity, invalid input, network failure, guest conversion where supported; no promise of Steam authentication.
screens.acceptance: Retry never creates duplicate accounts and successful creation preserves the requested destination.

screens.title: Guest entry
screens.purpose: Explain temporary identity and its real persistence limits before play.
screens.layout: Compact two-choice entry panel with a concise consequence statement, not a full-screen legal wall.
screens.primaryAction: Continue as guest after reading the existing warning.
screens.data: Guest-session limitations and account alternative; only describe guarantees backed by authentication behavior.
screens.art: Small club-pass illustration and simple solid identity icon.
screens.narrow: Centered readable panel; two full-width actions with no footer navigation.
screens.input: Focus first on explanation, then account alternative and continue; Escape returns to title.
screens.states: Creating session, failure, sanitized internal redirect; warning cannot vanish while request is pending.
screens.acceptance: Continue communicates the actual guest limitation and preserves safe redirect behavior.

screens.title: Dynasty selection
screens.purpose: Choose a saved world and understand its state at a glance.
screens.layout: A game library: three large dynasty tiles per desktop row; selected tile expands a right detail area; roster/class libraries occupy an explicit Tools section.
screens.primaryAction: Continue selected dynasty.
screens.data: League name, team, current phase/week, mode, last activity and membership; owned files in separate library view.
screens.art: Campus postcard per dynasty with athletic monogram; art never replaces league identity.
screens.narrow: One featured dynasty and a paged library; top section chooser for Dynasties / Files.
screens.input: Arrow navigation proposed within tiles; Enter opens; deletion remains a distinct explicit command.
screens.states: No dynasties, unavailable memberships, guest, loading, file preview and deletion confirmation.
screens.acceptance: No destructive icon masquerades as Play; mode and destination are legible before opening.

screens.title: New dynasty
screens.purpose: Configure a coherent text simulation or Power Pros companion without an intimidating form.
screens.layout: A four-step coach desk: mode, competition, roster/class sources, review. Keep a readable configuration summary at right.
screens.primaryAction: Create the reviewed dynasty.
screens.data: Existing season length, conferences, team count, difficulty and source selections; clearly distinguish simulated games from reported games.
screens.art: Small miniature diamond responding visually to selected program, not to unimplemented gameplay settings.
screens.narrow: Step counter at top and one current step; review opens as a full panel.
screens.input: Keyboard step sequence; proposed bumpers switch completed steps; do not advance past validation failures.
screens.states: Unavailable sources, incompatible settings, pending generation, duplicate submit and role restrictions.
screens.acceptance: Review reproduces exact submitted configuration; no mode-dependent field silently survives incompatibly.

screens.title: Competition selection
screens.purpose: Select the participating schools and understand competition structure.
screens.layout: Conference rail at left, athletic monogram school grid center, selected-field counter and rules summary right.
screens.primaryAction: Confirm selected teams.
screens.data: Team totals, conference membership, prestige and existing full-season requirements; selection capacity continuously visible.
screens.art: Team monograms in consistent badge containers; no reliance on missing logos.
screens.narrow: Conference selector then paged team grid; selected count remains in top toolbar.
screens.input: Keyboard toggles with named selected state; intended controller grid navigation and dedicated review action.
screens.states: No available schools, full-season constraints, saved selection, rejected configuration and unauthorized access.
screens.acceptance: Selection is preserved across conferences and review identifies every selected school.

screens.title: Coach and school setup
screens.purpose: Establish who the player is and which program they coach.
screens.layout: School selection list beside a coach media-day profile preview; second step edits coach identity, appearance and existing skill allocation.
screens.primaryAction: Confirm coach and program.
screens.data: School prestige/facilities, claimed status, archetype and actual skill budget with consequences.
screens.art: Cel coach portrait and athletic monogram; restrained campus miniature behind selected school.
screens.narrow: School choice and coach editor become sequential full panels with persistent summary.
screens.input: Keyboard accessible sliders/selects; proposed controller changes selection, never silently spends skill points.
screens.states: School already claimed, invalid name/allocation, unassigned coach, save error and existing coach.
screens.acceptance: Cannot confirm a claimed team or overspent skill budget; appearance preview reflects saved values.

screens.title: Dynasty lobby
screens.purpose: Show exactly what must be complete before a league can start.
screens.layout: Clubhouse gathering scene above three compact readiness rows: coaches, recruiting class and schedule; coach seats beneath.
screens.primaryAction: Start dynasty for authorized commissioner; join/claim seat for eligible coach.
screens.data: Assignments, human/CPU distinction, source readiness, invite controls and explicit blockers.
screens.art: Cel coach silhouettes in assigned seats with school monograms; avoid implying users are online unless presence says so.
screens.narrow: Readiness checklist first; expandable coach list; top invite action only for permitted role.
screens.input: Focus moves from blocker to corrective action; future controller navigates seats and readiness items.
screens.states: Waiting for coaches, missing class/schedule, generation pending, unauthorized start and stale setup.
screens.acceptance: Start remains unavailable with explanation when prerequisites fail; invited coaches cannot see commissioner-only mutations.

screens.title: Creating dynasty
screens.purpose: Make a long setup operation understandable without fabricated progress.
screens.layout: One stadium construction vignette and a vertical list of actual completed/current setup stages; summary panel replaces animation on failure.
screens.primaryAction: Enter dynasty when ready; retry only when supported and safe.
screens.data: Real operation stage, elapsed time and recoverable error explanation; no invented percentages or ETA.
screens.art: Subtle campus lights turn on by verified milestones; reduced-motion static equivalent.
screens.narrow: Single centered stage list; stage text wraps without clipping.
screens.input: Focus success action only after completion; Escape must not imply cancellation of server work.
screens.states: Pending, stalled, failed, already complete and navigation away/back.
screens.acceptance: Refresh reattaches to actual operation state; completion is based on server evidence, not animation timing.

screens.title: League invitation
screens.purpose: Let a coach verify a league before joining it.
screens.layout: Invitation card with league monogram, commissioner-provided identity and membership context; account status in upper corner.
screens.primaryAction: Accept invite or sign in to continue.
screens.data: League name, available role/seat where known and validity; avoid displaying hidden league data.
screens.art: Paper club invitation using forest and brass; no celebratory success before acceptance.
screens.narrow: Centered card with clear top back and in-panel actions.
screens.input: Keyboard confirmation and preserved focus; proposed controller confirm/cancel.
screens.states: Invalid, expired/revoked or exhausted invitation, existing member, signed out and joining error.
screens.acceptance: Every invalid invitation has an honest reason when safe and a usable return path; double clicks cannot duplicate membership.

screens.title: Matchday brief
screens.purpose: Answer what happened, what needs attention and what the coach can do next.
screens.layout: Viewport-oriented clubhouse desk: next game and primary action center; compact objective list left; latest meaningful result and readiness right. Deep league information moves into named detail tabs.
screens.primaryAction: Resolve highest-priority coach task, then mark ready when allowed.
screens.data: Mode, season/week/phase, lineup readiness, remaining actions/NIL, next opponent and server-backed blockers.
screens.art: Miniature home diamond hero kept shallow enough that useful decisions are above the fold.
screens.narrow: One Matchday / League top switch; next action first, selected detail full-screen; no duplicate footer menu.
screens.input: Keyboard landmarks and explicit focus; proposed controller cycles three zones then selects rows.
screens.states: No team, commissioner-only view, offseason, waiting on peers, reported games pending, offline and interrupted advance.
screens.acceptance: Current mode changes the verb: prepare/report/review versus simulate/advance; unknown results never appear final.

screens.title: Roster command
screens.purpose: Evaluate the full roster and make lineup decisions without scanning repeated mini-tables.
screens.layout: One continuous 44–52px-row manifest with pinned player identity; tabs Roster / Depth / Development. A 32% right inspector shows selected athlete, role, attributes and allowed actions. Position chips filter this one table.
screens.primaryAction: Inspect player; switch to Set lineup for arrangement.
screens.data: Number, portrait/name, position, year, handedness, labeled overall, captain/status; optional hitting/pitching metrics via column presets. Hometown moves to inspector.
screens.art: Cel portrait large enough to establish identity in inspector; field diagram only in Depth; no campus banner above every table.
screens.narrow: At 1280×800 retain list plus inspector; below 900px use full-width manifest and a full-screen player panel with Back to roster preserving selection.
screens.input: Up/down moves selected row; Enter opens detail; intended controller left/right changes zones. Depth offers select-player/select-slot instead of requiring drag.
screens.states: Empty position, no matching filters, opponent read-only roster, development permission, incomplete lineup, saving and invalid role assignment.
screens.acceptance: Whole roster is one table; no one-player position cards; filtering and returning from profile preserve context; no hidden offscreen columns are required.

screens.title: Team scouting dossier
screens.purpose: Understand another team's current strength and upcoming challenge.
screens.layout: Team crest masthead, record and identity strip; Summary / Schedule / Roster / Coaches / School / History tabs in a fixed workspace.
screens.primaryAction: Scout roster or prepare the next matchup.
screens.data: Actual team record, schedule, roster, coaches, facilities and history; opponent information obeys existing visibility.
screens.art: Monogram plus miniature campus crop and small coach portrait.
screens.narrow: Selected tab consumes canvas; team selector in top toolbar rather than stacked cards.
screens.input: Keyboard tabs with active state; proposed controller tabs and named list/inspector zones.
screens.states: Missing team, future opponent, own team action permissions and absent historical data.
screens.acceptance: Opponent view never grants roster editing; summary numbers match underlying roster and schedule.

screens.title: Program profile
screens.purpose: Tell the long-term story and identity of a school.
screens.layout: Editorial program cover with monogram and a shallow campus scene; record ribbon; legacy timeline and factual facilities/identity panels.
screens.primaryAction: Explore program history or open current team.
screens.data: Prestige/facilities, titles, recruiting history and school context already available; separate current season from career totals.
screens.art: Miniature campus is the hero; brass trophy silhouettes and photographic-style cel framing.
screens.narrow: Cover shrinks; chapters open one at a time with top chapter selector.
screens.input: Keyboard timeline selection; proposed controller chapter movement with Back to team.
screens.states: New program, no titles, missing school data and read-only opponent.
screens.acceptance: No invented historical achievement fills empty space; every statistic labels its time range.

screens.title: Coach profile
screens.purpose: Show a coach's identity, career and authorized development choices.
screens.layout: Cel coach profile at left; Career / Attributes / Skills / Strategy / Settings become chapter panels at right with a persistent season context.
screens.primaryAction: Inspect career; improve/edit only one's own authorized coach.
screens.data: Career record, badges, season history, recruiting grades, personality, perk trees, coaching strategy and notification settings where actually permitted.
screens.art: Media-day coach portrait, club credential and understated badge shapes.
screens.narrow: Portrait collapses to top identity strip; full-width active chapter.
screens.input: Keyboard chapter navigation; perk selection previews effect before any spend; proposed controller navigates tree with explicit node labels.
screens.states: Own versus other coach, unassigned, route without league context, unavailable career data and failed preference save.
screens.acceptance: Public coach routes never expose private preferences or edit controls; spent/available points are unambiguous.

screens.title: Program identity
screens.purpose: Choose a coherent baseball philosophy with readable tradeoffs.
screens.layout: Four playbook panels: offense, pitching, recruiting pitch, culture; selected choice at left and actual effect details at right.
screens.primaryAction: Save an eligible identity change.
screens.data: Current identity, candidate descriptions, real gameplay effects/costs/locks; do not invent hidden modifiers.
screens.art: Monogram and solid baseball silhouettes; faint chalk diagram outside text area.
screens.narrow: One category at a time with a four-item top selector and saved-state summary.
screens.input: Keyboard radio groups; proposed controller selection followed by explicit Apply.
screens.states: Read-only observer, phase lock, unchanged draft, unsaved changes and rejected save.
screens.acceptance: Selecting a card previews; only Apply changes state; restrictions include actionable explanation.

screens.title: Coaching rivalries
screens.purpose: Give recurring matchups personality while keeping records credible.
screens.layout: Mine / League selector; large selected matchup card center; rivalry list left; head-to-head chronology right.
screens.primaryAction: Open next matchup or inspect rivalry history.
screens.data: Existing rivalry intensity/context, coach names, series record and factual moments.
screens.art: Opposing monograms and cel coach busts; understated versus composition rather than combat imagery.
screens.narrow: List opens a full rivalry panel; back preserves filter and selection.
screens.input: Keyboard list selection; proposed controller focus on matchup and chronology.
screens.states: No rivalry yet, mine unavailable without team, missing opponent data and read-only history.
screens.acceptance: No procedural insult or rivalry cause is fabricated; each record links to available game evidence.

screens.title: Recruiting desk
screens.purpose: Compare targets and spend scarce attention with confidence.
screens.layout: A two-row situation strip replaces the overflowing Command Center carousel. Below: dense searchable board 65%, selected-recruit inspector 35%; filters stay in a top command row.
screens.primaryAction: Take an allowed recruiting action on selected prospect.
screens.data: Interest/stage, stars and scouted attributes, offer/NIL, visits, competition, team needs and remaining actions. Unknown scouting stays explicitly unknown.
screens.art: Cel selected recruit and quiet campus postcard in inspector; solid status icons with text; restrained rivalry accents.
screens.narrow: Situation strip becomes two columns; board keeps identity, position, interest and action status; inspector opens as full panel.
screens.input: Keyboard sortable table and focusable filters; intended controller row selection, inspector switch and action menu; no hover-only tooltips.
screens.states: No targets, budget/action exhausted, phase lock, signed recruit, failed mutation, CPU/read-only coach and out-of-date board.
screens.acceptance: All six command summaries fit without horizontal clipping; costs and resulting balance shown before spend; no duplicate actions from animation or retries.

screens.title: Recruit scouting profile
screens.purpose: Make an athlete feel like a person while exposing enough data for expert recruiting.
screens.layout: Half-body cel portrait left; identity and fit summary center; Info / Attributes / Common / Pitches / Priorities / Abilities panel; relationship and offers at right.
screens.primaryAction: Scout, recruit or review offer when authorized.
screens.data: Scouting certainty, attributes/abilities, pitches only for pitchers, priorities, current competition and action cost.
screens.art: Media-day framing and school-neutral scouting card; never use portrait styling to signal hidden gem/bust status.
screens.narrow: Portrait becomes compact header; data tabs full width; action bar belongs to panel top, not global footer.
screens.input: Keyboard tab navigation and named action buttons; proposed controller stat groups rather than every tiny cell.
screens.states: Unscouted, partial scouting, committed, signed, orphan/missing recruit and phase or role lock.
screens.acceptance: Hidden ratings remain hidden in all tabs and exported views; back returns to same recruiting filters.

screens.title: Transfer portal
screens.purpose: Evaluate transfers as immediate roster choices with eligibility and cost context.
screens.layout: Portal manifest with position/year filters and availability badge; selected transfer dossier; commitment/interest action panel.
screens.primaryAction: Pursue or make permitted transfer offer.
screens.data: Origin school, eligibility, attributes visible to coach, offer status, NIL impact and available roster slots.
screens.art: Cel athlete with small origin monogram and neutral portal badge; no generic recruiting-star celebration.
screens.narrow: Manifest to full detail panel; key year/position/status stay visible.
screens.input: Keyboard selection and explicit offer confirmation; proposed controller uses same list/inspector pattern.
screens.states: Closed portal, no entrants, ineligible targets, own-team departures, filled roster and failed offer.
screens.acceptance: Roster and budget consequences are visible before committing; stage-closed state cannot look like an empty search.

screens.title: Committed class
screens.purpose: Show how a class fits the program and where it ranks.
screens.layout: Current class ribbon and a compact position-needs matrix; team-class table with selected team detail; past rankings via season selector.
screens.primaryAction: Review own class or view a committed athlete.
screens.data: Committed versus signed status, class count, ranks/grades from actual data, position mix and past class history.
screens.art: Cel recruit tiles with consistent monogram frame; no card-back gimmick for already known information.
screens.narrow: Own class first; switch teams in top picker; ranks remain a separate clear view.
screens.input: Keyboard class and season selection; proposed controller athlete carousel with explicit count and buttons.
screens.states: No commits, teams without commits, pending signing and missing past class.
screens.acceptance: A verbal commitment never appears as a completed roster arrival; rank and season are clearly labeled.

screens.title: Signing day and arrival ceremony
screens.purpose: Celebrate actual arrivals and leave a useful class record.
screens.layout: Proposed only: Clubhouse Arrival staged on miniature home diamond; nameplate slide; media-day half-body athlete; final arrival sports profile. My class / All teams / All recruits remain accessible.
screens.primaryAction: Choose a spotlight player, play or skip reveal, then inspect the arrival card.
screens.data: Actual signed status, player identity, position/year and authorized scouting/attributes; preserve class roster even after skipping.
screens.art: Frisk's unapproved R01A R02D R03A R04A R05B R06A R07A R08C R09A R10B recipe: warm welcome, clubhouse signature, program scrapbook, choose spotlight, coach's cut.
screens.narrow: Landscape stage scales around portrait and nameplate; portrait view prioritizes card; skip/replay in top controls.
screens.input: Skip and sound accessible before motion; keyboard Enter reveal/Escape skip; controller behavior proposed only.
screens.states: Already viewed, no signed class, reduced motion, muted sound, missing portrait and locked/unavailable reveal.
screens.acceptance: No new recipe ships without approval; skipping never mutates signings; scrapbook/export must exclude hidden/private data.

screens.title: League departures overview
screens.purpose: Understand which programs are losing players and where future roster needs arise.
screens.layout: League departure ledger with team selector and Graduation / Draft / Portal category filters; selected program shows departing athletes and source status. Any returning-roster projection is a later addition requiring verified data.
screens.primaryAction: Inspect departing player or open the team's permitted departure workflow.
screens.data: Existing team-by-team graduates, draft declarations, transfers and total leaving. Keep source-declared departures distinct from any future forecast.
screens.art: Cel portrait and academic/diamond silhouettes; continuity timeline restrained.
screens.narrow: Grouped list first; player detail replaces it; persistent projected roster count.
screens.input: Keyboard list and group navigation; proposed controller selects groups then athletes.
screens.states: No departures, incomplete current-season data, missing player, pending versus final source status and read-only opponent.
screens.acceptance: Category totals reconcile with actual departure rows; no assumed returners or speculative draft result is presented as confirmed.

screens.title: Departure decisions
screens.purpose: Resolve exits and retention choices with clear roster consequences.
screens.layout: My team / Roster preview / League tabs; decision queue left, selected player and consequences center, remaining budget/roster summary right.
screens.primaryAction: Make a permitted retention decision or finalize reviewed departures.
screens.data: Graduation, draft and portal categories, relevant retention cost, finalized state and projected next roster.
screens.art: Cel athlete and understated farewell program card; no celebratory animation on loss.
screens.narrow: One decision at a time with queue count; roster preview becomes full-screen mode.
screens.input: Keyboard decision review; explicit confirmation for finalization; proposed controller never confirms destructive action on initial press.
screens.states: Pending decision, impossible retention, finalized/read-only, stale roster projection and failed finalization.
screens.acceptance: Final confirmation names affected players and irreversible effects; back/cancel cannot submit; official totals refresh after success.

screens.title: Cuts and walk-on bids
screens.purpose: Fill real roster gaps while making the cost of cuts and bids visible.
screens.layout: Roster capacity strip at top; My roster / Available walk-ons / Results views; selected athlete panel and bid summary.
screens.primaryAction: Place eligible bid or review a cut.
screens.data: Current/projected roster count, bid commitments, budget, role needs and signed/outbid results.
screens.art: Cel player portraits with practice-field backdrop; distinct neutral bid versus signed states.
screens.narrow: Single list view and full detail panel; capacity always remains in top strip.
screens.input: Keyboard numeric bid entry, named increase/decrease controls; proposed controller has discrete bid steps and explicit cut confirmation.
screens.states: Auction open/closed, no funds/space, simultaneous outbid, won player, cut pending and network failure.
screens.acceptance: Cut confirmation identifies player; displayed available funds reflect pending obligations under actual rules; results never imply all bids won.

screens.title: Season schedule
screens.purpose: Find the next game and distinguish played, reported, disputed and final results.
screens.layout: Week ribbon above a fixture list; selected matchup details at right; team/conference filters in command row; exhibitions remain explicitly labeled.
screens.primaryAction: Prepare next game; Report, Review or View result according to actual mode/state.
screens.data: Week/date, teams, home/away, score/status, submission owner, confirmation/dispute state and available action.
screens.art: Athletic monograms and a restrained scoreboard header; no repeated campus heroes.
screens.narrow: Week controls and fixture list; selected matchup expands into full panel.
screens.input: Keyboard week previous/next and fixture selection; proposed controller bumpers change week and confirm opens details.
screens.states: Future, simulated final, report pending, disputed, rejected, stale submission, postponed/absent data and spectator.
screens.acceptance: A pending report is visually distinct from official score; no simulation button appears for companion-only workflow.

screens.title: Game preparation
screens.purpose: Translate roster information into a clear pregame decision.
screens.layout: Broadcast matchup header; probable pitchers and key comparisons center; own lineup and scouting notes in adjacent panels; Prep / Lineup / Matchup chapters.
screens.primaryAction: Review lineup or open the next legal match action.
screens.data: Matchup meter and keys based on existing calculations, pitcher/lineup details, head-to-head and team identity.
screens.art: Small miniature ballpark under scoreboard, cel starter portraits and clear away/home labels.
screens.narrow: Two-sided comparison becomes paired metric rows; lineup has its own full panel.
screens.input: Keyboard chapter navigation and select-slot lineup alternative; controller field navigation proposed.
screens.states: Unscheduled game, missing roster/lineup, own versus observer, locked lineup and companion mode.
screens.acceptance: Advice is labeled analysis rather than certainty; companion does not pretend to send a lineup into Power Pros.

screens.title: Report a Power Pros game
screens.purpose: Record a real played result accurately and make review errors easy to fix.
screens.layout: Three-step scorer desk: evidence/input, review, submit; scoreboard remains fixed at top; batting and pitching panels switch by team.
screens.primaryAction: Submit reviewed report or save/edit permitted draft.
screens.data: Official game identity, score, innings and actual supported batting/pitching fields; OCR uncertainty and validation shown adjacent to cell.
screens.art: Scorebook typography using Inter tabular numerals; school badges and paper-like inset on forest.
screens.narrow: One team/stat group at a time; summary always reachable by top Review command; no giant horizontally clipped grid.
screens.input: Keyboard cell navigation, input labels and error focus; controller text entry and grid editing require later dedicated validation.
screens.states: Wrong participant, unsupported mode, OCR incomplete, contradictory totals, stale edit, pending approval and server rejection.
screens.acceptance: OCR never auto-confirms; review lists all blockers; submit success reflects server response and preserves source/provenance labels.

screens.title: Play-by-play unavailable
screens.purpose: Explain the unavailable feature honestly and return to useful game information.
screens.layout: Deliberate unavailable panel within game shell with matchup context and a clear result/schedule destination.
screens.primaryAction: Open schedule or supported game result.
screens.data: Only current game identity/status and factual availability explanation.
screens.art: Quiet scoreboard illustration; no fake playback timeline or Play button.
screens.narrow: Compact full panel and top Back.
screens.input: Keyboard primary action; proposed controller back/confirm.
screens.states: Legacy links, missing game and unsupported play-by-play.
screens.acceptance: No fabricated pitch sequence or dead-end spinner; route remains explicitly unavailable until evidence supports a real feature.

screens.title: Postseason hub
screens.purpose: Make the tournament path and next obligation instantly clear.
screens.layout: Round selector above bracket scene; selected game inspector and qualification summary; conference/national stages get explicit stage headings.
screens.primaryAction: Open next eligible postseason matchup.
screens.data: Seeds, series state, advancement, next game, official/pending status and bracket source.
screens.art: Brass tournament lines over dark forest with restrained trophy silhouette.
screens.narrow: Round-by-round fixture list replaces a squeezed full bracket; previous/next round buttons maintain path.
screens.input: Keyboard selects game then round; proposed controller uses bracket neighbors with list alternative.
screens.states: Before qualification, incomplete bracket, live series, disputed report, eliminated team and champion.
screens.acceptance: Bracket does not advance on unconfirmed scores; every small node has a readable list equivalent.

screens.title: Championship presentation
screens.purpose: Celebrate verified achievement and connect it to the season record.
screens.layout: Champion monogram and cel team composition; short optional entrance; recap chapters for bracket, final rankings and awards.
screens.primaryAction: View season recap or continue to offseason.
screens.data: Champion, season, final series scores, awards and rankings from completed data; no placeholder winner.
screens.art: Miniature diamond confetti kept subtle, brass trophy centerpiece, snapshot-ready composition.
screens.narrow: Hero scales without clipping title; chapters open full-width; skip at top.
screens.input: Skip/replay keyboard controls and reduced motion; proposed controller chapter selection.
screens.states: Season unfinished, championship missing, viewed before, muted sound and missing awards.
screens.acceptance: Celebration appears only for confirmed champion; skipping never advances league or bypasses offseason decisions.

screens.title: Statistics desk
screens.purpose: Compare baseball performance efficiently with honest data coverage.
screens.layout: One dense sortable leaderboard with batting/pitching and team/player presets; selected athlete inspector; season/scope filters anchored top.
screens.primaryAction: Sort or inspect a player/stat line.
screens.data: Existing statistical columns, qualifying sample and actual season/source coverage; report missing companion stats explicitly.
screens.art: Cel leader portrait in inspector; clean scorebook typography dominates.
screens.narrow: Essential columns fit; metric presets and detail panel replace horizontal travel.
screens.input: Keyboard sort controls and row navigation; proposed controller metric-group cycling.
screens.states: No recorded stats, partial reported box scores, zero denominators, unqualified player and unavailable source.
screens.acceptance: Unknown/missing is not zero; rate stats carry sample context; all columns are reachable without native horizontal rails.

screens.title: Record book
screens.purpose: Make achievements searchable and credible across seasons.
screens.layout: Library chapter rail for supported records, coach legacy, recruiting history and Hall of Fame; selected record detail with source season.
screens.primaryAction: Inspect a record holder or season.
screens.data: Record value, category, holder, team, season and existing qualification rules; ties and empty categories explicit.
screens.art: Brass record plaques used for leaders only; dense ledger for full list.
screens.narrow: Chapter selector top; one ledger then full record detail; no decorative trophy walls pushing data down.
screens.input: Keyboard chapter/search/row selection; proposed controller page navigation.
screens.states: No completed seasons, tied records, missing archived player and read-only historical values.
screens.acceptance: Historical versus current records never mix without labeling; Hall of Fame eligibility remains actual game rule.

screens.title: Season archive

screens.title: Storyline hub

screens.states: No stories, already voted, expired vote, hidden intel, commissioner-only command and failed request.

screens.title: Commissioner office
screens.purpose: Operate a shared league with clear boundaries and consequences.

screens.states: Non-commissioner denial, read-only inspection, preflight fail, pending reports, recovery required, stale operation and permitted save states.

screens.title: Commissioner roster editor

screens.title: Roster browser and comparison

screens.states: No source, missing team, read-only source, unsaved changes, compare incomplete and failed save.
screens.acceptance: Comparison labels source and each player; custom copy never silently overwrites the original.

screens.title: Recruiting class studio
screens.purpose: Create and manage reusable classes with deliberate load/share actions.

screens.title: Shared class showcase

coverageNotes: Design proposal dated 2026-09-18, grounded in client/src/App.tsx route declarations and current page components. It is not a claim that these redesigns or controller support are implemented.

50 screen entries cover all 51 explicit App.tsx route paths. The catch-all NotFound screen has routes:[] because App.tsx has no explicit catch-all path string. Three coach profile paths share one screen specification.
War Room is a redirect and play-by-play intentionally unavailable; neither should be revived by a visual redesign. Unrouted legacy files are not separate live screens.
30 tab/overlay specifications supplement route coverage. Existing tab names and role/mode conditions remain preserved unless a later implementation explicitly migrates them.

Approved base direction: Varsity Club; cel illustration; miniature campus; Sora/Inter friendly-console typography; forest/brass; matchday brief; sports profiles; athletic monograms; solid silhouettes; expert density; restrained broadcast motion; clubhouse sound.
Frisk's arrival R01A R02D R03A R04A R05B R06A R07A R08C R09A R10B recipe remains proposed, not approved. No ceremony, sharing or scrapbook feature is considered shipped by this document.
No footer navigation. Desktop uses left command rail/top HUD. Narrow screens use top Menu and one focused panel, preserving a game workspace rather than stacking a long mobile dashboard.

Native scrollbar rails are removed visually without disabling content scrolling. Required content needs named column/page controls, edge cues, keyboard focus and preserved touch/wheel behavior. CSS overflow:hidden is not an acceptable blanket solution.

Desktop and future Steam/handheld are design targets, not certified platform support. Packaging, controller mapping, platform authentication, cloud saves, offline expectations and Steam Deck verification remain independent dependencies.
All screen input descriptions are acceptance targets. Existing keyboard semantics must remain functional; proposed controller actions are not advertised as implemented.
Existing API permissions are authoritative. Roster commissioner-role response shape requires real authenticated API QA; synthetic preview role fixtures cannot establish correct permissions.
Power Pros companion screens must distinguish externally played/reported/pending/disputed/confirmed results. No design implies direct Power Pros synchronization or invents league rules.
Each implementation must verify loading, empty, stale/offline, error, own/opponent and role-denied states with real response shapes using synthetic data, as well as visual desktop/narrow inspection.

Priority P0: shell and roster/recruiting/hub/schedule/report/commissioner core loop. P1: remaining operational flow. P2: history, richer presentation and tools after core usability, with arrival gated on approval.
